dedupe_keys.name: fluxopt multi period energy optimisation package

description: fluxopt is a Python package for energy-system optimisation built on linopy. It represents carriers, flows, converters, storage and effects such as cost over detailed dispatch time steps or multiple planning periods. A user supplies demand profiles, import and conversion limits, technology choices and an objective; the package builds a solver model and returns operation or investment decisions and flow results. Geographic coverage is defined by the connected ports and system entered by the modeller, with no fixed map. MIT-licensed source and a pip package are public, and the quick-start example uses a gas boiler and heat demand with the free HiGHS solver included. A limitation is that the README labels the API early-stage and subject to change; users should pin a version for reproducible studies. fluxopt supports local electricity and heat capacity studies. The catalogue's model-pypsa is a separate energy modelling framework for comparison. No quick-start optimisation was executed.
